name: Andrew Yu
thesis: I teach people what AI can actually do.
support: Then I build the labs and demos that let them do it without me in the room.
oneLine: Andrew Yu teaches people what AI can actually do, then builds the labs and demos that let them do it without him in the room.
about: Andrew Yu is a technical writer and AI educator in Seattle. He is Lead Technical Writer at Salesforce and Director of AI Enablement at Claude Dojo, a nonprofit where he and his fellow instructors have taught 103 people to build with Claude Code. Before that he wrote developer documentation at Pinecone and led a content strategy team at Splunk. He studied English at UC Berkeley, and he builds every day with Claude Code.
